edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the Lottery constructor, making ownership caller-controlled at deployment.
msg.sender is stored into the players array slot players[nbUsers].
msg.sender is pushed into the users struct array as the bettor address.
The fallback calls checkinter before registering the player.
checkinter invokes endLottery when endBlock <= block.number and endBlock != 0.
callback, callable by the owner, also invokes endLottery to settle a frozen round.
endLottery hands control to withrawWin, which performs the external payout.
withrawWin executes winner.transfer, an external call that forwards control to an arbitrary address.
The external transfer happens before lastWinner is written, so a malicious winner can reenter while win/lastWinner state is inconsistent.
fees += tempTot * 5 / 100 performs unchecked integer arithmetic on the fee accumulator.
withrawWin resets nbUsers to 0.
withrawWin resets totalBets to 0.
withrawWin writes the winning ticket into lastWinnerTicket.
withrawWin increments totalGames.
withrawWin resets endBlock to 0.
withrawFee performs owner.transfer, an external call to a caller-influenced owner address.
fees is zeroed only after the external transfer, allowing reentrant withdrawal of the same fees.
destroykill executes selfdestruct(owner), irreversibly destroying the contract.
winningNumber is computed from block.blockhash modulo totalBets, an unchecked modulo operation.
sum accumulates users[i].amount without overflow checking.
Loop index i iterates over the users array to find the winner.
The fallback increments nbUsers for each new bet.
totalBets += msg.value accumulates the pot with unchecked arithmetic.
endBlock is derived from block.number + 15, making round timing block-number dependent.
The winner parameter is the destination address of the external transfer call.
tempTot determines the 95% payout amount sent by winner.transfer.
tempTot is scaled by 5/100 when crediting fees.
withrawWin binds its winner parameter to the address supplied by endLottery.
withrawWin binds its winticket parameter to lastWinnerTicket.
getPlayerAddress reads the players array using its index parameter without bounds validation.
getPlayerBet reads the bets array using its index parameter without bounds validation.
The isOwner modifier gates withrawFee on require(msg.sender == owner).
The isOwner modifier gates destroykill on require(msg.sender == owner).
The isOwner modifier gates the callback function on require(msg.sender == owner).

normalization_plan.reason: The index parameter only exists to index players inside getPlayerAddress and carries no independent semantics.
The index parameter only exists to index bets inside getPlayerBet and carries no independent semantics.
The winner parameter is consumed directly by withrawWin to perform the payout transfer.
The winticket parameter is consumed directly by withrawWin to record lastWinnerTicket.
The onlyIf modifier parameter has no call site; it is folded into the round-timing control function it duplicates.
The sum accumulator is a purely local helper of endLottery's winner selection loop.
The winningNumber local is computed and consumed entirely within endLottery.
The loop counter i is an implementation detail of endLottery's iteration over users.
The tempTot local caches totalBets only inside withrawWin for the fee and payout split.
